posts.title: Comfy in the wilderness
posts.description: Yesterday was a little chilly (44 degrees) but it was such a treat since I’m from where it’s over 100 degrees every single day of the year. The sun’s out today… I’m so grateful.. Thank goodness in a few months, I’ll be by the water with my husband and experiencing all four seasons!!!!! I’m so excited!!! (Side note: I’m trying to post some more pictures and none of them are uploading properly ugh.

posts.title: A new month!
posts.description: Happy April ! I pray that this new month is kind to you. that’s all, that’s the post !
